# Align Care

> Align Care connects people and families with compassionate, evidence-based mental health and substance use treatment — matched to clinical needs across the full continuum of care, from interventions and sober companions to therapy, IOP/PHP, medical detox, and residential treatment.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Align Care and how we match people to the right level of care.
- [Services](/services): Addiction treatment, professional interventions, sober companions, therapy, IOP, PHP, medication management, detox, and residential treatment.
- [About](/about): Our mission, clinical approach, and the team behind Align Care.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach a care navigator by phone, email, or secure message — free and confidential.
